task.root_cause: token_present() did NOT stop at exists(). It fell through to legacy_get() whenever the protected store reported nothing — always, on a self-signed build. legacy_get performs a real secret-data keychain read. The function's own comment claimed it "NEVER triggers a presence prompt". The comment was wrong.

rejected_hypotheses.item: eager get_token on startup — DISPROVEN by code trace
login keychain lock state — DISPROVEN by reading keychain.rs

task.solution: Token moved OUT of login keychain into app-owned encrypted file under Application Support, AES-256-GCM, gated by existing LAContext (no entitlement required). token_present is Path::exists only, no fallback. Migration reads legacy once inside get_token, writes new store, deletes legacy item. Never both places.

verification.check: Fresh launch, no dialog, no SecurityAgent process
Login keychain locked, launch, no dialog
Migration ran once, legacy item deleted, pipeline functions. Token itself REJECTED by KSeF test server, status 450 — month-old credential, not a defect. Dialog identity not visually confirmed.

task.constraint: Self-signed cert "VoxFaktura Developer", TeamIdentifier not set. kSecAccessControlUserPresence requires Apple-chained identity — structurally unavailable. Always Allow was tried repeatedly and NEVER held. ACL persistence is a dead end. Do not propose it.

instruction.rule: VERIFY-AFTER-WRITE must assert content shape: parses, no literal backslash-n outside intended escapes, imports resolve, build exit code recorded. Re-reading alone INVALID. EXTENSION 2026-08-05: applies to DELEGATED work — if you hand a write to another agent, re-read the file yourself. Do not relay another agent's report.
Timestamps from system clock, cross-checked against mtime, delta over 120s is a hard stop.
Numbered backlog, stable IDs. Letters may not be reassigned.
DONE = implemented + committed + build green + operator-visible. All four.
Candidate-side only. Recruiter-side is a hard stop requiring new intended-purpose assessment under the EU AI Act.

rules.rule: Evidence work goes ONLY through a substrate that can produce ls -la and SHA-256.
Coordination between substrates: e-mail only. MCP for data extraction, never coordination.
Web search: Tavily only. If unavailable, return UNRESOLVED.
Never request or accept operator passwords, OAuth tokens, or session cookies.
Comments in code describe intent, not behaviour. Any line reading "this NEVER..." is a candidate for verification. Established twice today.
Attachments do not survive the Outlook Mobile compose path. Paste text into chat instead.
Three "claimed done, file untouched" events in 24 hours. Assume this class by default.
